stepwell-low-after2.see: A square desert-sand platform on a dark grid featuring a sunken stepped well filled with green water, an arched stone back wall, and three small wooden racks holding terracotta pots.
stepwell-low-after2.wrong: Stretched and distorted mesh geometry clipping along the right edge of the pit, jagged mesh seams, and the tile floating over a dark grid.

stepwell-table-after2.see: A high-angle view of a square desert platform set against a dark grid, showing a square sunken stepwell containing green water with small pot stands arranged around the edges.
stepwell-table-after2.wrong: A stretched and misaligned mesh fragment protruding and clipping near the upper-left edge of the well, and the platform floating over a dark grid.
